settings.intro_highlight: The Natura Spa is a premier professional treatment chair engineered for versatility and precision, offering a height range of 22" to 39" to ensure optimal ergonomics for both the practitioner and the client.
settings.custom_description: The EI-509 Natura Spa is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including Estheticians, Medical Spa Therapists, and Cosmetic Injectors. Its adjustable height targets postural strain during full 8-hour shifts, enabling sharper focus on treatment execution and overall service consistency. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, body wraps, or post-procedure recovery, this clinical device adjusts to your multi-technician adaptability.
settings.subtitle: Precision Engineering for Professional Excellence
settings.secondary_description: Structural integrity is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the supple texture and clean appearance of the EI-509 Natura Spa, perform daily wipe-downs with non-abrasive surface cleansers formulated for professional spa environments. The commercial-grade upholstery exhibits high chemical and tear resistance, ensuring pristine condition across extended operating years. Consistent care prevents surface degradation and extends equipment operational lifespan.

settings.question: Practicing aestheticians:
settings.answer: For practicing aestheticians conducting detailed facial regimens, precise positioning is critical to reducing physical neck strain. The height adjusts from 22” to 39”, allowing the clinician to maintain an ideal posture while keeping hands free during active facial protocols.

settings.question: Clinical Spa Technicians & Spa Therapists:
settings.answer: For clinical spa technicians executing high-volume body services, stability under weight changes is necessary for uninterrupted workflow. Weighing 185 lbs, the station supports stable positioning throughout full-body treatments, minimizing frame movement when clients recline or shift position.

settings.question: Cosmetic injectors performing precise aesthetic procedures:
settings.answer: For cosmetic injectors performing precise aesthetic procedures, repeatable working angles prevent shoulder fatigue over long clinic days. The adjustable-height design supports repeatable positioning, ensuring accurate alignment with ambient lighting and task-specific equipment without disturbing client relaxation.

settings.text: Adjust the table height within its listed 22-to-39-inch range for the treatment.
If using the optional crescent headrest, secure and adjust it for the treatment.
Guide the client onto the center of the continuous cushion, ensuring balanced weight distribution before adjusting the table.
Return the table to its lowest position for client egress before sanitization.
Ensure all client load weights remain well within approved structural capacities to prevent structural strain.
Keep the floor area around the base frame clear of stools, power leads, and debris during elevation sequences.
